wos.dialog-title: Web of Science API Query Details
wos.database-id-hint: Database to search. WOK represents all databases.
wos.edition-hint: Edition(s) to search. Example: WOS+SCI. Multiple values can be comma-separated.
wos.lang-hint: Language of search. Use en for English.
wos.created-time-span-hint: Filter by first creation in Web of Science. Format yyyy-mm-dd+yyyy-mm-dd
wos.modified-time-span-hint: Filter by modification time in Web of Science. Format yyyy-mm-dd+yyyy-mm-dd
wos.tc-modified-time-span-hint: Filter by times-cited modification time. Format yyyy-mm-dd+yyyy-mm-dd
wos.time-span-type-hint: Choose one time span parameter to send.
wos.time-span-type-hint-wok: For WOK, only createdTimeSpan is allowed.
wos.time-span-date-hint: Date range in API format: yyyy-mm-dd+yyyy-mm-dd
wos.usr-query-hint: User query for requesting data, e.g. TS=(cadmium).

incites.title: InCites Query Settings
incites.esci-hint: Flag to include (y) or exclude (n) ESCI content in baseline metrics.

ids-file.title: File with IDs
ids-file.help1: Provide a file that includes one ID per line instead of using Web of Science API query.
ids-file.required: A file with IDs is required when query usage is disabled or token validation is missing.
